description: 0–100 composite with classification band and per-dimension breakdown (quality / coverage / quantity / UI signal groups), each line showing observed counts, thresholds, and awarded points.

requirements.description: The score response must include a composite score in the range 0–100 with an associated classification band (e.g. Excellent/Good/Fair/Poor or equivalent). The response must also include a per-dimension breakdown covering the four signal groups: quality, coverage, quantity, and UI signal. Each dimension line must display: observed counts, the applicable threshold values, and the awarded points for that dimension. The sum of per-dimension awarded points must equal the composite score. Dimension vocabulary and thresholds must be sourced exclusively from packages/maturity-go.
requirements.title: 0–100 Composite Score with Classification Band and Per-Dimension Breakdown
